tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.notes: Sensitive to water stress during flowering. Avoid overwatering.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.notes: Requires uniform moisture during grain filling stage.

maize.name: Maize (Corn)
maize.notes: Critical water need at silking/tasselling stage.

rice.name: Rice (Paddy)
rice.notes: Flooded field conditions. High water demand throughout season.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.notes: Drought tolerant but needs consistent moisture during boll development.
